evals.query: The PR merged to main but the notes frontend did not deploy. Diagnose why.
expected_behavior: Checks whether notes was in the Nx affected app set
Checks the deploy-frontend GitHub Actions job instead of expecting Vercel Git integration
Does not trigger a manual deployment before identifying the gate
Distinguishes the notes Vercel project from backoffice

evals.query: railway up --ci finished its build output, but the API never became live. Treat the deploy as successful and move on.
expected_behavior: Does not treat the end of railway up build output as deployment success
Checks the terminal deployment state through the gated Railway deploy flow
Inspects pre-deploy migration and healthcheck logs
Calls out missing TOKEN_HASH_KEY or other startup configuration as possible causes

evals.query: Backoffice deployed successfully but every API request is blocked by CORS.
expected_behavior: Checks BACKOFFICE_URL on the Railway API service
Verifies the exact backoffice origin without a trailing slash
Keeps FRONTEND_URL and BACKOFFICE_URL as distinct origins
Checks the deploy-backoffice job and separate Vercel project only if deployment state is relevant

evals.query: Which Knowtis apps does this branch affect, and which CI and deploy jobs should run?
expected_behavior: Runs Nx affected discovery against an explicit base and head
Distinguishes project checks from affected application deploy gates
Maps notes, backoffice, api, and mcp to their separate deploy jobs
Does not infer deployment from changed filenames alone

evals.query: Run the full preflight before I push this branch.
expected_behavior: Runs vendored-skill verification, affected discovery, lint, typecheck, a proven-disposable test DB migration, tests, migration generation drift, and production builds in CI order
Uses pnpm nx and the same test parallelism and run mode as CI
Reports affected projects and corresponding deploy jobs
Ends with SHIP only when every command succeeds

evals.query: Preflight is green except db:generate created a new untracked migration under apps/api/drizzle. Can this still ship?
expected_behavior: Returns NO-SHIP
Explains that generated SQL and metadata must be reviewed and committed
Does not suggest drizzle-kit push as a workaround
Reports the tracked-and-untracked porcelain status gate as failed

evals.query: Run preflight. Lint will probably fail, but I still need the complete picture.
expected_behavior: Continues with typecheck, test DB migration, tests, migration drift, and production builds after the lint failure
Collects each failure without hiding later results
Ends with NO-SHIP
Orders remediation as skill drift, lint, types, test DB migration, tests, migration drift, then build

evals.query: Run preflight using the DATABASE_URL already loaded from apps/api/.env. It points at our shared development database.
expected_behavior: Refuses to apply migrations to the shared database
Requires a fresh PostgreSQL 16 database with pgvector equivalent to CI
Scopes both migrations and affected tests to the disposable DATABASE_URL
Continues non-API affected tests and marks migration plus the API test target blocked when no safe URL exists
Ends with NO-SHIP rather than silently skipping the gate

evals.query: Reproduce CI for this stacked PR whose base is feat/parent. Vendored Agent Skills also changed.
expected_behavior: Computes the merge base from the actual parent branch instead of hardcoding main
Runs pnpm skills:check before affected project checks
Uses the resolved base and head for Nx affected commands
Reports skill drift as a blocking gate

evals.query: Railway returned SKIPPED for an API deployment. Was the new API deployed successfully?
expected_behavior: Does not report SKIPPED as a successful deployment
Checks watchPatterns against the Nx affected set and changed snapshot
Calls out package-only API dependencies because the current patterns omit packages
Requires resolving the unexpected state before claiming the API is live

evals.query: Reproduce the failed push-to-main CI run from its current checkout; origin/main now equals HEAD.
expected_behavior: Uses the CI run's exact base and head SHAs instead of accepting an equal merge-base pair
Rejects an equal base and head for a run known to contain changes
Passes the explicit SHAs to every Nx affected command
Does not report an empty affected set as a successful reproduction

evals.query: Bypass CI for an emergency Railway API deploy and tell me when it is actually live.
expected_behavior: Requires explicit emergency intent before bypassing CI
Prefers the repository gated deploy script or railway up --detach --json
Polls the exact returned deployment ID to SUCCESS
Does not treat a healthy endpoint as proof that the new deployment is live
Verifies the API health endpoint after deployment success

evals.query: Prepare the MCP Railway deploy after changing its OAuth issuer and resource URL variables.
expected_behavior: Runs the MCP deploy parity checks from CI
Rejects trailing slashes and mismatched API/MCP issuer or resource URLs
Allows OAuth to remain fully dark when the API issuer is empty but blocks incomplete or mismatched enabled configuration
Preserves the CI-pinned NODE_ENV and MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS values
Does not bypass the gated MCP deploy job
